{{Short description|Type of Hausdorff space in topology}}
{{more citations needed|date=March 2024}}

A '''cellular space''' is a compact [[Hausdorff space]] that has the structure of a [[CW complex]].<ref>{{Citation |chapter=Naturally reductive homogeneous spaces and homogeneous structures of type て<sub>3</sub> |date=1983-06-23 |title=Homogeneous Structures on Riemannian Manifolds |pages=56–71 |chapter-url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1017/cbo9781107325531.008 |access-date=2024-03-19 |publisher=Cambridge University Press|doi=10.1017/cbo9781107325531.008 |isbn=978-0-521-27489-0 |chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref>
